data.one_liner: Parse an SVG path string into a dart:ui Path object.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter and Dart utility package that allows developers to parse SVG path strings into equivalent Path objects from the dart:ui library. It supports handling various SVG path commands including cubic Bézier curves and absolute or relative movements.
use_when: You need to render custom SVG path strings directly onto Flutter canvases or CustomPainters.
You want to convert vector graphic path data into a standard Path object.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured SVG rendering engine to load and display complete .svg files.
You are not working with raw SVG path data string components.
strengths: Simple and focused API for parsing SVG path strings.
Supports null safety and multiple platforms including web, mobile, and desktop.
weaknesses: Limited to parsing path strings rather than rendering full SVG documents.
No built-in widget for full SVG file rendering.
